tbl_description: One row per Continuous Underway Fish Egg Sampler (CUFES) sample, as exported by SWFSC (Cufes.csv): the sample's identifier, cruise and ship, start and stop time and position, underway temperature, salinity, wind and pump speed at each end, and the six egg counts.
Egg counts per CUFES sample in long form (measurement_type = <taxon>_eggs, units count) and the standardized concentration derived from them (<taxon>_eggs_per_m3, units count/m3).
